quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Annual securities report (fiscal year ended March 31, 2026): under the Grow UP 2026 mid-term plan's focus on Uniqueness & Presence businesses, the company completed the capacity expansion of BT materials for semiconductor packages in Thailand during the year, in anticipation of semiconductor market growth. Demand for OPE(R) substrate material for AI servers is growing ahead of plan, and the company states it is considering establishing manufacturing sites for it.

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Grow UP 2026 mid-term plan final-year targets (the company's fiscal 2026 = fiscal year ending March 2027) restated in the annual securities report: net sales 8,500, operating profit 850, operating margin 10% or more, ordinary profit 950, EBITDA 1,500 (100 million yen), ROE 9% or more, ROIC 8% or more, on assumptions of 135 yen per US$ and Dubai crude at US$80 per barrel; versus actuals for the fiscal year ended March 2026 of net sales 7,382, operating profit 452, ordinary profit 519, ROIC 3.2% and ROE -6.1%. Segment targets: Specialty Chemicals net sales 4,900 and operating profit 650 (fiscal year ended March 2026 actual: 4,483 and 438); Green Energy & Chemicals net sales 3,500 and operating profit 220 (actual: 2,869 and 56). Management states the ICT field is the growth driver: centred on ICT, it will further expand electronics materials sales, harvest the returns on electronics chemicals investments (production being strengthened in Japan and overseas) and build a new lens monomer plant; in Green Energy & Chemicals it is expanding iodine production capacity to meet strong demand; and R&D resources will be concentrated on three target areas (ICT, mobility, medical/food).
quarterly_data.figure: Targets for the fiscal year ending March 2027: net sales 8,500, operating profit 850 (100 million yen), operating margin 10% or more; Specialty Chemicals operating profit 650 (100 million yen)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Restructuring stated in the annual securities report: the company decided to cancel construction of the MXDA (meta-xylenediamine) plant at its Netherlands manufacturing subsidiary, citing construction delays, soaring construction costs and changed market conditions, and is reviewing the whole xylene chain; it also decided to stop the polycarbonate production facilities at the Kashima plant, where losses continue and improvement is judged difficult, and has completed consolidating sheet/film production sites. Impairment losses for the year totaled JPY 78,448 million (Green Energy & Chemicals JPY 56,145 million, Specialty Chemicals JPY 22,302 million), including the Netherlands MXDA subsidiary, the Taiwan semiconductor-chemicals subsidiary and other China and Taiwan manufacturing subsidiaries in inorganic chemicals, and polycarbonate assets.
quarterly_data.figure: Impairment losses JPY 78,448 million (Specialty Chemicals JPY 22,302 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): group R&D expense JPY 26,636 million with about 1,078 R&D staff (about 13% of employees); Specialty Chemicals JPY 15,750 million, Green Energy & Chemicals JPY 10,885 million. Electronics materials R&D covers high-frequency circuit materials, laminate materials for memory and logic semiconductor package substrates to handle higher data-communication capacity, and thin laminates and fine-circuit-formation materials for lower-profile, higher-function electronic components. In inorganic chemicals, the company is refining purification of its main ultra-pure hydrogen peroxide and developing new grades of functional chemicals (HBC) covering semiconductor front-end through back-end processes under a global R&D structure. Other themes include optical resin polymers for smartphone camera lenses extending to automotive, AR/VR and sensors, transparent polyimide (solvent-soluble, fluorine-free) and thermoplastic polyimide (high heat resistance, low dielectric).
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 26,636 million (Specialty Chemicals JPY 15,750 million); about 1,078 R&D staff
